notes: Current EKR 2.11 recognizes/mandates one-pipe conversion, individual emitter controls, hydraulic balancing, conditional cast-iron radiator replacement and other secondary-side measures inside its stated scope.
The source requires a hydraulically balanced system or balancing during the measure; existing valves require review/verification.
Large-water-volume sectional cast-iron radiators trigger replacement under the source condition; no population frequency follows.

Source table contains 4/6/10% base cases and conditional +3% radiator-replacement/temperature-reduction and +1% heat-reflector effects, reaching 8/10/14% source-native accounting cases. These are not transferred to AWHP.
The +3% EKR case requires replacement of all large-water-volume cast-iron radiators and at least 7 C supply-temperature reduction; this is a measure condition, not an AWHP setpoint.
Current EKR 2.11 excludes application when a new energy carrier is introduced into heating. Therefore its saving percentages cannot be used as direct heat-pump programme response.

Existing P67 authority: new emitters, secondary heating circuit, HMV tank, controls, modern pipework, materials, installation and removal; 1,422,400 material + 2,133,600 labour = 3,556,000 HUF/set maximum.
